column1: # ngram(min2,max3) treats the WHOLE query string as one char stream (no
# whitespace split) → a multi-word query is just a LONGER substring → more
# grams AND'd → smaller intersection. Groups quantify the selectivity gradient
# from a single broad gram (synthetic worst case) to a realistic release-name
# fragment. Per-group p50/p95/p99 reported for Count and (with --topdocs) the
# --- a1: single broad term (the synthetic worst case = PS-MB1 ascii3/4 floor)
# --- a2: two-word space-separated (as typed in a search box) -----------------
# --- a3: dotted realistic release-name fragments (how paths actually encode) -
# --- cjk2word: realistic CJK title fragment + qualifier ---------------------
